mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 56 degrees and a moderate air quality index of 55. We are under a Third Quarter moon, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Public Works Department reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles all curbside refuse and recycling. You can find collection schedules or use their Waste Wizard tool on the city website to properly dispose of any item.

There is a great lineup of events starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and catch live music at Paddy Mac's throughout the week.
In a noteworthy call from October 21, the Verona Police Department assisted emergency responders during a witnessed cardiac arrest on Batker Court.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by to enjoy a scoop later this morning.
